apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.0  (November 2026)  THE PASTOR'S ROLES WAIT FOR YOUR OK; SECURITY RULES 57
  - Who handles the church's money (Disbursing Officers, Treasurers, Approvers, Auditors) is no longer changed by itself when
    the pastor changes the Roles on the phone. Beacon Finance asks once ("Accept this change now?"), and Portal Finance Roles
    shows the waiting change with Accept the pastor's change. Until it is accepted, everything stays as it was here (the
    pastor's page on the phone shows what Beacon Finance still has). So a change made on a phone alone can never give anyone the
    right to approve or release money.
  - When the church's website needs a newer Beacon Finance (Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything says so), this program says
    "Please update" and sends nothing to the portal until it is updated; reading still works.
  - Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 57 (Website Update 106).

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.42.0 - TWO COMPUTERS NEVER DO A PHONE CHANGE TWICE; PORTAL AND RULES COPY = WEBSITE UPDATE 106 (rules 57)
  - Beacon Secretary on the phone: each change is first CLAIMED by one computer (a write only one computer can win), then done.
    The Secretary computer and the Attendance computer at the door both sync, and at the same moment both could add the same
    new member; now only one does. A claim not finished after 10 minutes (that computer stopped) may be taken by the other.
  - When the church's website needs a newer Beacon Secretary / Attendance (Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything says so), the
    Member Portal part of the sync stops with "Please update" until it is updated (Google Drive still syncs).
  - Removed files nothing used: login_window.py, qr_checkin.py, qr_scanner.py, nav_menu.py.
  - Portal copy = Website Update 106: Beacon Pastor on the phone reads only the prayer requests not followed up and those of the
    last 6 months; the portal checks the church check-in only while it is on the screen. Rules 57.
